instruction: The italic text appears too large for my preference. Current font size is 12 and I want to reduce the font size of all italicized words to 10 to make them less prominent. Can you help me?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing font size of all italic text from 12pt to 10pt. Evaluator checks if all 21 italic runs have font size 10. Verified document has 21 italic runs currently at 12pt that need resizing to 10pt.
